resources.string: This is exactly the text that will be copied. It is in German because DB handles claims in German.
Enter your ticket price to see the claim text.
DB asks you to sign in on bahn.de or in DB Navigator. Paste the text there, or use the paper form. Come back and confirm below once you have sent it.
Get back what a late train owes you
Delayd notices your train rides, checks how late you arrived and prepares your claim for DB passenger rights.
25 % of the fare from 60 minutes late, 50 % from 120.\nDeutschlandticket: €1.50 per delay, collected per month.\nNothing is paid below €4.
How it works, and what stays private
Everything runs on your phone. There is no account.
Your location history never leaves your device.
The only thing sent is a timetable lookup for the station area, to Transitous.
No ads, no tracking, no analytics.
Two permissions make this work. You can change them any time in Settings.
You can continue without them, but rides will not be detected until location is allowed.
Needed to see where a ride starts and ends, even when the app is closed.
Only approximate location is allowed. Allow precise location so stations can be matched.
To tell you when a train was 60 minutes late or more, and when a monthly claim is ready.
Android will not ask again. Open app settings and allow it there.
Battery optimisation can stop apps that work in the background. Letting Delayd run unrestricted keeps detection reliable and costs very little battery.
In the list, find Delayd and choose “Don’t optimise” or “Unrestricted”. You can skip this and do it later.
Compensation is a share of what you paid for each journey.
A fixed amount per delay, claimed once a month.
Not allowed. Rides cannot be detected.
Not allowed. You will not hear about delays.
Optimised. Android may pause detection in the background.
Trips are stored only on this phone. Export them as JSON, or delete everything.
All trips and claim statuses on this phone are removed. This cannot be undone.
